title: Free Coordinates in a List
statement: Let $\eta$ assign each of the $n$ coordinates a state that is either free, fixed at $1$, or fixed at $-1$, and let $L$ be a list of coordinates. The resulting state assignment makes coordinate $i$ free if $i$ occurs in $L$, and otherwise leaves its state as $\eta(i)$.
